rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making an identical copy, including copying computer files.

example.english: I need to copy this document.
example.traditional: 我而家要複製呢份文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 fuk1 zai3 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for copying written material by hand or transcribing it, not for general duplication or computer copying.

example.english: Please copy this set of notes for me.
example.traditional: 呢份筆記你幫我抄一份。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bat1 gei3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 caau1 jat1 fan6

rows.note: Use 一份 for one copy of a report, document, or other distributed material.

example.english: I want a copy of this report.
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 jiu3 jat1 fan6

rows.note: Use 一本 for one physical or digital copy of a book.

example.english: I want a copy of this book.
example.jyutping: nei1 bun2 syu1 ngo5 jiu3 jat1 bun2

rows.note: Use this for copying a person's actions, behaviour, style, or movements rather than reproducing an object.

example.english: Don't copy me all the time.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 mou4 fong2 ngo5

rows.note: Use A貨 for a counterfeit or imitation branded product, especially one sold as a cheaper substitute.

example.english: This designer bag is a copy, but much cheaper.
example.traditional: 呢個名牌袋係A貨，平好多。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 ming4 paai4 doi6 hai6 A fo3 ping4 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this in office or email contexts when sending someone a copy of a document or message.

example.english: Please copy the Finance Department on this email.
example.traditional: 請喺呢封電郵抄送畀財務部。
example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 ni1 fung1 din6 jau4 caau1 sung3 bei2 coi4 mou6 bou6

rows.note: Use 一期 for one issue of a magazine, journal, or other periodical.

example.english: I haven't read this copy of the magazine yet.
example.jyutping: nei1 jat1 kei4 zaap6 zi3 ngo5 zung6 mei6 tai2
